scenarios.requirement: A typed letter in a window waiting for an assistant reply changes nothing and says the assistant is working, once
scenarios.note: red on 10788a3: says=0 (the old refusal painted the bar without being counted); green with the owner's sayer

scenarios.requirement: After Esc frees the window a typed letter is text again and nothing is said
Each refused letter in a waiting window says its line: the one-line latch is cleared when the next key is read
scenarios.note: red when the latch is never cleared (second letter says 0); red on 10788a3 (says=0)

scenarios.requirement: When the reply lands and its review is up, the status row no longer says the assistant is working
scenarios.note: green on 10788a3; red on pass A: the held line outlives the wait

scenarios.requirement: A paste into a waiting window after a refused letter is refused and its line is on the status row
scenarios.note: red on pass A: the line goes on the paste's first key and the latch keeps the paste silent; green while the key loop keeps the line for the rest of a refused paste (red when e_status_key_pressed runs on every key); it cannot see whose line it is, the row below does

scenarios.requirement: A paste into a waiting window after a refused letter says its own line once: its first character says one line, the rest of the paste none
scenarios.note: red when the latch set by the letter holds into the paste (no clear at the wait and none at the paste's first read: says=0); green with either clear

scenarios.requirement: A man page window is read-only by its nature, not by the mode of its temporary file
scenarios.note: needs man; green on 10788a3 for an ordinary user (the 0400 file and access make it read-only), red only for a user who may write anything, such as root
